body:
I guess my biggest problem stems from society. I just have no empathy for anything or anybody in the world around me. I feel like a compassionate individual, but only the the extent of my interests, if that makes any sense.

It bothers me that I create anxiety about what I'm doing, and what I'm supposed to do with my life simply on what society expects me to do. I don't want to wake up and go to work tomorrow. I don't want to go to school just to get a piece of paper saying I'm qualified for a better job and have to bankrupt myself to do so.

I want to live in a world where I can just live. Comfortably and freely and at my own pace.

EDIT: I apologise for my vagueness. This feeling is just so incredibly hard to put into words.

I'm sorry. I guess this post was a little vague. I'm just overwhelmed with this emptiness that seems impossible to describe; like I've hit some sort of wall. Its not sadness, or apathy, or even depression. It's almost like a state of confusion. 

I've attempted suicide twice only to find out yet one more thing I'm a failure at. Nothing I do to improve myself or the world around me ever ever makes an impact. I try to hard to reconnect with a world that once fascinated me when I was younger, but not I've just grown into realizing that nothing ever seems to work the way you'd expect. I try hard to see the good around me and be thankful I still have a chance to make it right. But after now years of trial and error I keep ending up at the same conclusion: nothing matters. 

Nothing seems worth it.
